# A Workstation cold-boot test hits the 30 s test timeout in hosted CI

## Context

`test/playwright/component/workstation/WorkstationBoot.spec.mjs:209`, "a cold boot retains the saved workspace and Reset brings its pane back", fails now and then in the components tier's third shard. It fails on pull requests that do not touch the Workstation, and it passes on a re-run of the same commit. Every sighting ends the same way: `Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded`, while the last step waits for the Feed pane after Reset.

| Sighting | Run | Diff | Re-run |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-08, #20585 at `13bf619871` | 42456080122 | not the Workstation | green |
| 2026-11-16, #21070 | 43780773980, job 133017283355 | adds `apps/webdesktop` and a catalog entry | requested |
| 2026-11-17, #21206 at `d506b174f5` | 44000812835, job 133764156006 | adds `src/board` and catalog data | green (attempt 2) |

Locally it passes 22 of 22 at 3.0–4.3 s per run: 3 on `a442f37f3e`, 3 on #21206's head, and 16 on `a442f37f3e` with 8 workers. Vega measured 13 of 13 at 2.3–2.4 s on the first sighting.

## The Problem

A red that clears on a re-run costs every author a diagnosis and a re-run, and it teaches the team to re-run reds unread. This one has done so three times in nine days. The log cannot say whether the pane came late or never came, because the test timeout cuts the last wait short.

## The Architectural Reality

- The test tears the Feed pane out into a popup, then polls until the persisted topology lists the vessel workspace under the Group's key (up to 30 s). It closes the popup and the root, cold-boots a new page with the same Group identity, and clicks "Reset to default". Reset is `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs#resetTopology`, which `apps/workstation/view/TopologyToolbar.mjs` calls.
- The test's steps declare waits of up to 60 s (lines 83, 97, 98 and 245), but it runs under the component config's default 30 s test timeout. All three sightings were cut by that timeout during the last wait.

## The Fix

Discriminate first, then fix:

1. Read the failing run's artifact `test-results-components-44000812835-shard-3` (9 files, retained until 2026-12-01). Its error context holds the page snapshot at the timeout: a booted root without the Feed pane means Reset lost it; a root still booting means the runner was slow.
2. Slow: give the test a budget that covers its declared waits (`test.setTimeout`), so a loaded runner can finish. Lost: fix the Reset path for the ordering that drops the retained vessel workspace, and still align the budget.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The cause is named from the failing run's evidence: a slow runner, or Reset losing the pane.
- [ ] The test's budget keeps its waits after Reset whole (30 s for the saved topology, 60 s for the DOM) after a setup as slow as the failing hosted run. *(Restated at implementation: every declared wait in this test sums to about 465 s, which no CI budget should allow.)*
- [ ] If Reset loses the pane, a test reproduces that ordering and the fix makes it pass.

## Out of Scope

Other component tests whose step waits exceed their test timeout, and runner capacity or sharding (#18916).

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-17T15:08:55Z

**The artifact shows Reset committed, but its arrangement had not reached the DOM when the 30 s budget ran out.** With @tobiu's yes, I read `test-results-components-44000812835-shard-3`, the error context of the 2026-11-17 failure (run 44000812835). Its page snapshot at the timeout:

- **The cold root had finished booting.** Every dock group is rendered, the 100k grid shows its first 29 rows, and the toolbar counts "280/500 feed rows · 10 events/sec".
- **The reset had been committed.** The topology bar reads `Reset to default` [disabled], `Undo 1`, `Redo` [disabled]. That is one history row, and the main document already counts as the default.
- **The DOM still shows the arrangement from before the reset.** `bottom-tabs` holds only `Selection Inspector`, which is how the cold boot renders it while the Feed lives in its retained window workspace. No tablist holds "Live Event Stream".

So the commit landed and its projection had not. This artifact cannot tell a slow projection from a stalled one, because the 30 s test timeout cut the 60 s wait at line 245.

*(Corrected 15:2xZ. The first version of this comment read the snapshot as "Reset finished without the pane", and proposed a race in which the click lands before the retained workspace is registered. The code refutes that race. A cold boot registers every retained workspace synchronously, inside `Workspace` construction (`apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs:377`), before the toolbar is mounted (`ViewportController.mjs:250`). A late registration would also make the commit refuse on the exact key match, not record `Undo 1`.)*

**One more uncontrolled variable:** the "cold" page is `context.newPage()` in the same context, and the Workstation runs on a SharedWorker (`neo-config.json:10`). If the old worker is still alive when the page connects, `ViewportController#decide` adopts the live root (`:159-161`) and nothing hydrates. The e2e tier boots a fresh context restored from `storageState({indexedDB: true})` for exactly this reason (`WorkstationResetSurvivesReloadNL.spec.mjs`, header).

**Next, on a branch for this ticket:**
1. Give the test a budget that covers its declared waits (AC-2).
2. Boot the cold page in a fresh context restored from storage, so the cold path is guaranteed.
3. After Reset, poll the persisted topology until `main` lists the Feed and its window workspace is empty, and only then assert the DOM. That separates a document failure from a render stall.

If the Feed then never renders within the 60 s wait (locally, CPU-throttled), it is a stall, and AC-3's reproducing test follows. Otherwise the budget was the cause.
